verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a free tier, pricing plans, usage limits, or trial credits for Metorial. Sandbox environments and the source-available FSL license are related features, not a documented free tier, so they earn no credit. A pricing-plan question applies to a SaaS tool-connection platform, so missing evidence means none rather than na.
